The specific dates for the implementation of the approved rates will be determined. The Office of Information and Communications Technology, with assistance from the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget, has been updating system information to improve the alignment of revenue and expenditure monitoring and reporting within Umoja.
history.board_assessment: Given that the total cost of ownership project is ongoing, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: The Office of Information and Communications Technology completed a comprehensive cost analysis of its core services and associated expenses, with the primary objectives of: (a) determining the cost of services provided to other Secretariat entities; (b) establishing a transparent pricing model for each service; and (c) updating service rates. This exercise resulted in a more accurate and sustainable financial framework that reflects current operational realities and is aligned with best practices outlined in the cost-recovery policy and guidelines. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
